note: [agent-bulk] numucc_em. Only ONE shower in scope: 17012 (pdg 11, kine_charge 396.8 MeV, 12 seg, cluster 17+48+49) -- the other 11 showers are all sub-20 MeV 2-point stubs and I did not look at them. Vertex is good: judged from the vtx-* sweep at 92.7 cm half-span (r95 74.2, no vtxz frames -- event under the 150 cm trigger). The blue star sits exactly where the 79.1 cm pdg-13 track 17013 ends and the EM cone begins; the shower start X coincides with it, and az-055 and az+085 both show a single apex there. 17013 (the muon) is grey/unowned -- correctly NOT swallowed, so no over-clustering of a MIP stem. Members cover the whole visible cone and the yellow set has one apex and one direction in both azimuths. Under-clustering checked on the non-members: every unowned segment other than 17013 is either a 0.1-0.5 cm delta stub lying along the muon at 109-172 deg from the axis (44022 12.5 cm/109.3, 45023, 42020, 53040, 47025, 43021, 50039, 46024 out to 82 cm), or 17014, a 5.3 cm pdg-211 stub leaving the vertex at ~85 deg to the shower axis. Nothing grey sits in the forward cone. Membership triple-checked: nseg 12 == the 12 segments with owner 17012 == the 12 candidate rows carrying owner 17012. Two pdg-2212 rows are inside the member set (49038, 3.6 cm, in the shower's own cluster 49; 48026, a 0.1 cm 2-point stub at 22.8 cm / 18.8 deg) -- both tiny and forward, I do not read them as over-clustering. No pi0: no second EM object anywhere in the event, so no pio judgement is offered. Verdict is about clustering only and silent on PID.
